name: Statement & Assumption
shortcutSummary: An assumption is something that must be TRUE for the statement to make sense. If the statement remains meaningful even without the assumption, the assumption is NOT implicit.
conceptExplanation: Statement and Assumption questions test whether a given assumption is implicit (hidden/taken for granted) in the statement. An implicit assumption is an unstated premise that the speaker must believe for their statement to be valid.

subtopics.name: Statement & Assumption — Core Concepts
subtopics.explanation: Statement and Assumption questions test whether a given assumption is implicit (hidden/taken for granted) in the statement. An implicit assumption is an unstated premise that the speaker must believe for their statement to be valid.
shortcuts: Necessity Test: Remove the assumption — does the statement still make sense? If yes, it's not implicit.
Restatement Trap: If the assumption just restates the statement in different words, it IS implicit.
Extreme Words = Usually Not Implicit: Assumptions with "only", "best", "always" are often not implicit.
